en: Multiview tourist postcard with six color photos bordered in purple: a city street with a neo‑Gothic building and trolley wires; the grand facade of the Cluj-Napoca National Theatre/Opera; a Secession-style palace; two scenes from the Alexandru Borza Botanical Garden with greenhouses; and the equestrian Matthias Corvinus Monument in front of the Gothic St. Michael's Church. The reverse bears the caption "Cluj Kolozsvár Klausenburg" and the publisher credit "© Editura ALSAND", with standard address lines and stamp box.
